scope: Observed alternate Sweep profiles: planar-face recipe/body reference, open sketch Line and BRep edge recipe Paths, coplanar two-profile membership and controlled edge active extent. No Sweep geometry regeneration.

integration.dependency: Imports shared decode_sweep_modes plus existing typed selection helpers; never imports public decode_sweep.
integration.shared_opt_in: profile_resolver=None, allowed_header_vectors=((1,0,0),), allowed_new_body_anchor_counts=(1,) retain strict defaults. Opt-in reader returns profiles list, neutral header vector, result context IDs and post-anchor cursor; profile=None for collection. Two-result control96/count2 validates typed distinct context IDs, matching owner copies/counts; these are context records, not native bodies.
integration.default_compatibility: 16 default supported and22 extended supported prior outputs exactly equal committed source dictionaries. Six default unsupported cases remain rejected.

layout.closed_collection: One4BD descriptor/0D57 with profile-set count2; existing shared resolver frames each profile set independently. Native result-anchor count2 and control context count2; singular profile field intentionally null.
layout.open_sketch: Owned2CA->5A1BF descriptor->E2CEFD leaf resolves one native sketch ID and Line tag. Input temporary Profile normalizes to actual API Path.
layout.face: Owned5662 descriptor with bounded_face_recipe_data, typed historical body anchor and feature owners; exact face-to-ASM mapping remains opaque.
layout.edge: Owned5662 descriptor with edge_recipe_data, one typed context and historical body anchor. Actual API profile Path contains one BRepEdge, independently owning the named source surface body; exact edge-to-ASM mapping remains opaque.
layout.raw_header_vector: float64[3] atbase+14: prior supported captures(1,0,0); new face/sketch/collection(0,0,1); captured edge variant(0,-1,0). Neutral raw field, no coordinate-frame meaning assigned.
layout.edge_active_extent: Observed NewBody surface edge-profile mode2, header(0,-1,0), zero angles and Along0 uses AgainstDistance as API distanceOne. Full/partial.4 and reversed source Line contrasts establish this narrow branch; other header frames/modes rejected.

findings: All four initial cases exported successfully. Open temporary Profile getters reject token/sketch/plane/loop access; the initial actual Path token getter also failed. Corrected retry captures actual Path count/ordered members/opposition flag while preserving original failure evidence.

Partial edge API distanceOne.4 stores AgainstDistance.4 and Along0; new sheet independent API y-span1.2 equals source length3*.4. Reversing source Line endpoints keeps Against1 and API distanceOne1 with y-span3. Source line direction therefore does not switch this captured activation.

API feature.bodies includes the existing named source surface plus the new sheet for edge cases. Native new-result-anchor list contains one. API collection count is retained as observation, not equated to new-anchor count.
Two closed profiles retain separate curve tags102/104 under one descriptor; both profile sets are exposed. Actual API ObjectCollection has two Profile members.
Counted result-control references are typed C46D context records, not native body IDs. Matching context/result counts is observed; a per-context body mapping is not claimed.
limitations: Alternate variants currently only NewBody/mode2/straight single sketch Line/zero angles; face and collection solid, open variants surface. Only captured raw header vectors and profile combinations accepted.
Edge partial extent is supported only in observed Against-only branch/header combination; general profile frames, Along activation and two-sided/guide variants remain unsupported.
Exact BRep face/edge geometry, planarity reconstruction, trim curves and recipe-to-ASM topology identity unresolved; API source geometry is observational evidence.
Stored context payload meanings, header-vector frame, profile traversal/opposition flags, kernel regeneration and native writer unresolved.
API tokens/tempIds are opaque evidence and were not used as native IDs. Getter failures remain preserved in original ground_truth files.
